TC-02/S19.title: Census scan time and which AI read the photo (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home photos)
TC-02/S19.detail: Dev, build e02167f, dataset photo10 (scripts/datasets/run.sh; rows prefixed QA DS1-photo10, deleted after: 2 deleted, 0 left, no other row changed). 10 synthetic census photos (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home; rendered by render-media.mjs because the S06 photo set is not on disk) were each scanned once from the list header scan sheet, which was then closed without adding anyone. After every call diagnostics:list held one vision.scanCensusSheet row with model gemini-3.6-flash (not the vertex-configured-model placeholder), durationMs 2281-4457 ms (median 3052) and providerMs on all 10 (the app adds 2-10 ms). No call over 30 s, so nothing to list for review. 20/20 judged cells held (U10, T3). Not checked: the ai_disclosure audit row (disclosed_to google_vertex) and aiProvider:_current need admin reads outside the dev allowlist, so 'on Vertex' is shown only by the logged model id. Every scan showed 'No patients / No residents found': that is the known B01, recorded, not part of this case.
